summary_md:
# 282. Aktiepodden gästas av Eqvor

**Feed**: aktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-11-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode of Aktiepodden mostly features Filip Thunstedt, CEO of the unlisted-share trading platform Eqvor. He covers the unlisted market, liquidity, regulation and names traded on the platform: Blykalla, Estrid, Koenigsegg and Quartr. In the market segment the hosts are constructive. They say Asmodee's buy case is intact after a strong report, they think Nibe's share price drop after solid results was unjustified, they find the Vertevo spin-off from SKF interesting at a low valuation, and they see Munters as cheap. They are bullish on Nvidia and on AI over the long term.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ASMDEE-B — Asmodee | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Report beat consensus by wide margin; buy case intact; ~11x earnings next year; host regained confidence; held in Aktiespararna portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Organic growth ~33% vs consensus ~20%; TCG +52% on the Pokémon 30th anniversary; the company's own game publishing is also strong, which eases fears about tough Pokémon comparisons. Management expects continued organic growth and Pokémon growth next fiscal year, and demand exceeds production capacity. The stock is up ~60% YTD but still trades at ~11x next year's earnings. The host had considered stepping aside but decided to stay invested.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Pokémon TCG sales decline against tough comparisons
- if own game publishing fails to take over growth
- if organic growth guidance is cut

> *"Slutsatsen blir väl ändå att solid rapport, köpcase intakt, kanske man kan säga."*

---

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Solid report beat expectations but stock fell; host expects consensus margin upgrades, scale benefits and support from higher power prices; held in portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Nibe reiterated all its margin targets, and consensus looks low, so upward revisions are likely. Heavy capacity investment during the downturn should bring operating leverage as organic growth returns. The Elements unit benefits from data-center demand. Higher electricity prices this winter should drive heat pump adoption. Caveats: the valuation is not low, Climate Solutions growth (~10%) was weaker than Elements, and market confidence in the company remains weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Climate Solutions growth weakens further
- if consensus margin upgrades fail to materialise
- if German heat pump market/competition deteriorates

> *"Jag tycker att det finns flera delar som borde tala för den här aktien ett tag till."*

---

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Case of the week: even with cautious margin forecast the stock is very cheap; history of lifting profitability with volume.

#### Reasoning

The main risk is converting the large order backlog into profitable production while ramping up quickly with component shortages. Over the past decade the company has shown that margins rise with volume. The host expects margins just under the 14% target next year, and says the stock is very cheap even if margins only hold at today's level. The AI/data-center link supports demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins fall below current levels
- if production ramp bottlenecks persist
- if order backlog shrinks

> *"även med den lite försiktigare lönsamhetsprognosen att man kan mer eller mindre bibehålla nivån man ligger på idag så är aktien faktiskt väldigt billig."*

---

### 🟠 VERTEVO — Vertevo | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

SKF spin-off listing 1 Dec; ≥8% LT margin target vs 4-5% today; self-help levers; low valuation despite weak light-vehicle end market.

#### Reasoning

At the CMD the company set a long-term margin target of at least 8%, up from 4-5% today, to be reached by moving capacity in-house from SKF contract manufacturing. Improvements are largely in its own hands. 37% of sales are aftermarket, which lowers cyclicality. It is a global supplier including to Chinese OEMs and is strong in hybrids. The host calls it an exciting stock at a low valuation, but the ticker is not yet confirmed and the investments needed will take time.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin improvement stalls
- if light-vehicle market weakens further globally
- if required investments overrun

> *"men till en låg värdering jag tycker det är en spännande aktie slutmarknaden till trots"*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Beat estimates, raised growth outlook to 75%; hosts convinced AI growth will be underestimated long term.

#### Reasoning

Revenue and adjusted EBIT doubled YoY, both beat estimates, and next-year growth guidance was raised from 70% to 75%. The host is convinced AI will be far bigger than expected. He expects growth to slow from the build-out boom but stay strong for ten years, perhaps ~20% at steady state, and thinks recent AI skepticism may pause. No explicit buy recommendation was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth guidance is cut
- if the AI capex build-out cools faster than expected

> *"Men tittar man tio år framåt i tiden så är jag övertygad om att det kommer vara väldigt, väldigt fin tillväxt."*

---
